title: Better, Faster, Stronger (1989) + Writhelings
problem: In the Writheling block, the BFS part repeats the Pleasant Disease buff (one random buff per Writheling stack), not the Writheling's debuff. It runs even without Pleasant Disease. Text: "minions perform their effects twice".
notes: Community claim: Instead of a second debuff on an enemy, it gives a random ally a buff (like Pleasant Disease), and it stacks with Pleasant Disease. Evidence: bc_EventDamage L7055+ Writheling block (cond 46 @0x140f71555): debuff loop @0x140f72536; Pleasant Disease 1144 @0x140f729b5 → bc_EventBuff @0x140f7367d; BFS 1989 @0x140f73afc → bc_GetRandomBuff @0x140f73fcb → bc_EventBuff @0x140f747c4. Fix sketch: Make the BFS block repeat the debuff (bc_GetRandomDebuff / bc_EventDebuff on an enemy) (H) Triage 2026-10-26: BFS repeats Pleasant Disease's random buff instead of the Writheling debuff, even without Pleasant Disease. Hook: repeat the debuff. 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Better, Faster, Stronger + a creature with Writhelings (no Pleasant Disease); take an attack: each Writheling afflicts a random ENEMY with a random debuff twice (no random buffs on your creatures).

release_notes.effect: Better, Faster, Stronger with Writhelings (trait / minion)
release_notes.intended: Your creatures' minions perform their effects twice.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, for Writhelings the game repeated Pleasant Disease's random buff instead of the Writheling's debuff.
release_notes.fix: Now Writhelings afflict a random enemy with a random debuff a second time.
